title: PathOptions
description: Represents a set of options that define how DataBrew selects files for a given Amazon S3 path in a dataset.

allOf.description: If provided, this structure defines a date range for matching Amazon S3 objects based on their LastModifiedDate attribute in Amazon S3.
If provided, this structure imposes a limit on a number of files that should be selected.
A structure that maps names of parameters used in the Amazon S3 path of a dataset to their definitions.
